relevance_note: Cohort study of 37 VEOIBD patients whose supplementary Table S1 lists five individual patients with genotype 'TNFAIP3' ("The frequent mutations were found in TNFAIP3 (n=5)"), with per-patient sex, age at VCE, endoscopy findings and treatment.
method_note: A Python script in my scratch directory transcribed the five TNFAIP3 patients' rows (Patient 2, 5, 9, 12, 32) of supplementary Table S1, a fixed-width text table converted from PDF, by column start positions taken from the header; I checked the parsed cells against the table by eye. Columns: Case, Age at VCE, Gender, Genotype, Classification, Duodenum on VCE, Jejunum on VCE, Ileum on VCE, Colonic feature on colonoscopy, Ileal feature on colonoscopy, Gastric feature on gastroscopy, Duodenal bulb feature on gastroscopy, Descending part of the duodenum (the last two headers are split over two lines), Histology, Treatment. Patients with several VCEs have one row per procedure ('Patient 2 VCE 1' to 'VCE 4'); genotype, classification and treatment sit on the VCE 1 row, while Gender sits on one of the patient's rows (for Patient 2 and Patient 12 on the VCE 4 row, for Patient 5 on VCE 2): sex was taken from the row carrying the patient's own label, as a merged-cell placement. No stacked ' / ' cells. The table prints only the gene ('TNFAIP3'); no variant description, zygosity, inheritance or classification is given per patient, so each variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported'. Figure 1 ('patients with identified pathogenic variants') is a general cohort statement and was not used for pathogenicity. Age at last evaluation is the age at the patient's last VCE in Table S1; the column gives no unit, and years (ISO PnY) follow the text 'The VCE was performed at an average age of 7.8±3.2 years'. Onset age is not given per patient (VEOIBD onset before 6 years is a definition, not a per-patient statement). No country or ethnicity per patient (the study was run in China; not recorded as patient origin). Phenotypic features: one observed row per patient, location column and finding term across all of the patient's procedures (spellings 'edmea', 'erosin', 'redspott' grouped with 'edema', 'erosion', 'redspot'; spans prefer correctly spelled rows, max three); severity_or_detail lists the VCE rows and ages at which it was seen. 'normal' cells were recorded as excluded 'abnormal findings (<column>)' only when the column was normal in every procedure for that patient, written as broadly as the cell; 'normal' at only some time points was not recorded. Histology 'NA' and 'not performed' were not used. Group text not used for individual features: 'All patients with TNFAIP3 mutations except one suffered from ileal ulcers' (counts without names) and 'Patients with TNFAIP3 mutations also had colonic erosions and ulcers identified by colonoscopy', which does not match every row (Patient 32 colonic cell 'erosion' only; Patient 9 VCE 1 colonic 'normal'). Figure 4 describes 'Another patient with TNFAIP3 mutations, her small lesions did not improve during 4 years of follow-up' without a label; not assigned. Cohort-level counts (perianal disease, recurrent infections 4/37, treatments) name no one and were not used. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the paper cites its own prior work (refs 7, 8, 30) and says it extends an ESPGHAN e-poster, but does not state that these patients were described before.
